title: Aerial Images of US Attacks on Bridges in Bandar Khamir
text:
Aerial Images of US Attacks on Bridges in Bandar Khamir"

"In the US missile strikes on parts of Hormozgan Province, six bridges along the Bandar Abbas to Lar highway—located in the Bandar Khamir district—were struck, causing significant damage to this key road link."

"The bridges targeted in these attacks are:"

"· The Garyveh bridge on the Bandar Abbas–Khamir–Lar route"
"· The bridge just past Latidan village (Kelmatli)"
"· Two bridges on the Kahoorstan–Lar stretch of the return road between Bandar Abbas, Khamir, and Lar"
"· An unfinished bridge on the Bandar Khamir–Keshar–Bandar Abbas road"
"· The bridge near Marv village in Khamir county
